new_value: Verified already-fixed by merged commit 7331d087c5; no source change required. The predicate at rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:703-705 is exactly what the bead specifies: identity.iid == packet_source[8..] (link-local form, fe80:: carries IID in low half) OR identity.ygg_addr == packet_source (full routable). identity.ygg_addr is set to ygg_addr_from_pubkey(pubkey) in Identity::from_seed (lichen-link/src/identity.rs:72), so the second disjunct is precisely ygg_addr_from_pubkey(identity.pubkey)==packet_source. Both required forms accepted. Test-only code path. Baseline: cargo test -p lichen-node = 358 passed / 1 failed. The single failure (three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent, route-lookup not installed) is tracked by out-of-scope bead cpox per the bead's own scope note - not chased here. Note: initial cargo test failed with a spurious E0061 (AnnounceProcessor::new arity) caused by a stale incremental rlib in the shared cargo cache; resolved by touching lichen-rpl/src/lib.rs to force a clean rebuild (no content change). 1 reviewer-model pass attempted (timed out mid-turn); predicate correctness verified by direct inspection of both branches.
